jev_input.intent: Verify every adjacent state-event-state step in this complete supplied issue-list reuse trace against its explicit enabled transition relation. All values are known; do not synthesize. Preserve facts and route to workflow.transition_allowed verify. Supported cache shapes are unpaginated, since=None, text=None, normal SQL order classes, within pager-derived byte budget and reader-derived entry bound. Unsupported queries use direct SQL. Over-budget/unusual-order results return coherent SQL-loaded rows without retention and have explicit bypass counters. Ordinary commit races may return a dirty coherent snapshot retaining its ORIGINAL cursor; they must never be marked current. Validation identity/schema/generation/history resets and validation errors DISCARD the candidate and return an error; subsequent requests safely seed. This is declared finite policy for the S5 review fix, not a claim that Rust, SQLite, all races, or runtime performance are proved.
